name: PhotoPrism
tagline: A photo library for the folders you already have
description: A browsing and organising tool for an existing photo collection. Point it at your folders and it indexes them in place, adding places, labels, faces and search. It is a library, not a phone backup service.
licenseNote: The Community Edition is AGPL-3.0. Some features, including additional user roles and extra map styles, are reserved for paid memberships.

maturity.rationale: Stable and conservative, maintained by a small full-time team since 2018. It moves more slowly than Immich.

selfHosting.summary: A single container with MariaDB, or SQLite for small libraries, pointed at your existing photo folders. The documentation is clear; the first index is slow.

requirements.notes: Swap space is needed for indexing large RAW files and video.

managedHosting.label: PikaPods
managedHosting.note: Third-party managed hosting, billed by resource use

strengths: Indexes folders in place and leaves your directory structure alone
Strong browsing: places, calendar, labels, faces, RAW and video
WebDAV access lets desktop tools and sync apps write straight into the library
weaknesses: No first-party mobile apps or automatic phone backup: you pair it with a sync app
Multi-user support in the free edition is limited
Reads Google Takeout metadata, but albums and sharing need manual rebuilding
Slower development pace than its main rival

featureNotes.auto-backup: Through third-party sync apps or WebDAV
featureNotes.multi-user: Extra roles need a paid membership
featureNotes.takeout-import: Reads the metadata files; albums are not recreated
